title: Collections Officer
summary: A collections officer recovers overdue payments on retail loans and credit cards for a bank or NBFC (non-bank lender), by phone and in the field. You own a set of delinquent accounts by bucket (how many days overdue), work with collection agencies, and escalate hard cases to legal recovery within RBI rules on fair collection.
dailyDuties: Call and visit overdue borrowers and agree repayment plans
Track promises to pay and bucket-wise resolution
Allocate cases to collection agencies and review their work
Trace borrowers who cannot be reached
Recommend accounts for settlement or legal action
Update collection MIS and daily reports
Follow the fair practices code in every contact

skills.expectation: Hit bucket-wise resolution targets and control roll-forward of delinquent accounts
Contact and visit overdue borrowers, agree repayment plans and follow up promises to pay
Start legal recovery such as SARFAESI, Section 138, arbitration or settlement where needed
Follow RBI fair practices and the collections code of conduct
Allocate cases to collection agencies and monitor their performance
Maintain collection MIS and trackers in Excel
Understand retail loan and credit card products and their repayment terms
Talk to borrowers calmly and firmly in the local language
Read bureau reports to trace borrowers and judge repayment ability
Know NPA classification rules and how they drive bucket priorities
Read delinquency and roll-rate reports for the portfolio
Handle borrower complaints and disputes without escalation
Guide a small team of field or tele-collection staff
